title: Sleek and streamlined stainless kettle
text:
Sleek and streamlined stainless kettle. I had a faithful KitchenAid tea kettle for many years, until it finally rusted and became unusable, so I was looking for a replacement for making hot water for tea and other beverages.

In the past, I have owned several Kenmore appliances, but did not realize that they also made a line of housewares as well, so I was curious to try out the Kenmore Halsted tea kettle.

Out of the box, I was struck by the streamlined, modern appearance. It felt quite hefty upon picking up, and once filled with water, heated evenly and quickly and cleaned up like a breeze.

It also looks quite nice with any kitchen decor.

The only change I would like to see would be for it to have a metal handle assembly rather than a plastic one, but other than that, it works as intended and looks fashionable doing so.
